text: On XX/XX/XXXX, {$1700.00} was paid to Kia Finance company for my XXXX XXXX XXXX. The bank charged it back on XX/XX/XXXX and it was removed from my Kia account. I spoke with the bank and rectified the problem and they cancel the dispute and said it was a good charge and would not seek out to collect the money back. Kia said they sent the money back same day on XX/XX/XXXX and said it goes back immediately however no funds have returned to my bank and the back has said they have not received anything. At this point, XX/XX/XXXX, I have yet to receive my money back from Kia and they have removed it from my account and can not provide me any information on the missing funds and are essentially stealing the {$1700.00} from me. They also are now telling me that they never received the funds.
